verified.note: arXiv:1905.06971v1 (only version) Table II, sources/1905.06971.txt lines 242-244 (rx = 2.646); journal version not reached | Hartree, total energy of H4 (Table I caption: 'All the energies are expressed in Hartree'; Table II caption: 'All the energies are expressed in Hartree'; energies near -2.1 are totals). Geometry: rectangle, r_y = 2.4 a.u. fixed (text 'ry = 2.4 a.u.'), r_x as in the row; a.u. = bohr. Singlet N_up = N_dn = 2: the AGP is built from singlet pairs (Eqs. 3-5). Nuclear repulsion included (all-electron Hamiltonian; the trial basis only builds the trial state). Held value of arXiv:2605.17083 Table I, column JAGP(D), there quoted from Ref. 5 (this paper). Table II caption: DMC 'performed using the nodes of the JAGP'; the paper states it uses lattice-regularised DMC (LRDMC) for the fixed-node approximation (p. 1). The 'LRDMC' label for this column is implied by that sentence (RULES.md 8), the bound type 'projected' holds for either fixed-node DMC.
